other_failure_modes.name: Target Encoding Leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Target encodings are computed on the entire training set and mapped directly back onto it without using out-of-fold (K-fold) estimation. This introduces severe target leakage and causes tree-based models to heavily overfit to the encoding features.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong coding structure, implements specialized losses (Tweedie) for the zero-inflated target, and avoids leaking test data during preprocessing. However, the solution fails critically by ignoring the temporal nature of the data (using a random train/test split) and by introducing severe target leakage via in-sample target encoding. Additionally, the agent uses naive ensembling and does not account for the variance of its stochastic models.
